# Inventory

**16** components are in Accessible first. The components answers picked them (see [Components](../foundations/components.md)). Anything not in is out.

| Component | Family | In | Built | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alert | feedback | In | Yes | Errors and important notes that stay on the page. |
| Breadcrumb | navigation | In | Yes | Shows where a person is in the service. |
| Button | action | In | Yes | Every action, with a large target. |
| Card | layout | In | Yes | Groups a summary before submitting. |
| Checkbox | form | In | Yes | Many choices, each with a large target. |
| Collapsible | layout | In | Yes | Optional help a person can open. |
| Dialog | overlay | In | Yes | Only to confirm leaving with unsaved answers. |
| Field | form | In | Yes | Label, hint and error in the same place on every question. |
| Input | form | In | Yes | Text answers. |
| Label | form | In | Yes | Names every control. |
| Native select | form | In | Yes | A browser select that every assistive technology understands. |
| Progress | feedback | In | Yes | Shows how far through the steps a person is. |
| Radio group | form | In | Yes | One choice from a short, visible list. |
| Separator | layout | In | Yes | Breaks between groups of questions. |
| Spinner | feedback | In | Yes | Says that the page is working. |
| Textarea | form | In | Yes | Longer answers. |
